repository_default.scope: Default requested by repository owner; explicit source terms override it. Uncertain scope is flagged, never silently resolved by the default.

interpretation: This is an evidence-based source-header and notice-location map, not a new legal grant or a completed rights audit. Source copyright notices, exact upstream legal texts and theorem/publication provenance retain their scope. Imports and publication references do not by themselves assign a license to a local source file.

Apache-2.0.scope: Use the source-specific referenced variant and original attribution; variants are not normalized or automatically substituted.

AGPL-3.0.scope: Source identifier as written, not normalized to only/or-later. Exact project-license snapshots and any conflicts are recorded in LICENSES/source-evidence.json.
